scope: Analytic plane/cone (frustum) surface-surface intersection (fifth analytic SS slice, one cell): native intersect_plane_cone in crates/brep-core/src/intersections/plane_cone.rs, bridge op brep_intersect_plane_cone, typed TS adapter intersectPlaneCone. A new strict canonical conical-frustum recognizer (exact canonical solid, side surface certified as four ruled rational quadratic patches whose control points lie exactly on the linear radius taper between the two rings — certified against the ring centers with the height counted once, rigid affine placements admitted; a true-apex cone is admitted, an equal-radius frustum is a cylinder and is refused) pairs with the canonical planar-patch recognizer of the plane/quadric cells, unchanged. The plane operand is always first — swapped order is an explicit unsupported_surface region. In the apex frame the section satisfies the exact conic A2 x^2 - L x + y^2 + C = 0 with A2 = K(g^2 - sigma^2), K = 1 + m^2, sigma = |m|/sqrt(K), g = axis.n: perpendicular planes yield the exact circle of linearly interpolated ring radius with iso-v side lifts on the four side patches; through-axis planes yield two exact degree-1 rulings through the apex with iso-u side lifts; oblique planes yield the exact ellipse (|g| > sigma, clipped in the UV parameter), parabola (|g| = sigma within a pure-rounding angular snap, all weights 1) or hyperbola arcs (x = x_c +- a(1+t^2)/(1-t^2), y = 2bt/(1-t^2)) — every clip of the conic against the height ring planes and the patch rectangle is a closed-form rational-quadratic half-plane clip in the exact curve parameter, never iterated. The cone-side lift of the ellipse/parabola/hyperbola is null (no exact low-degree rational UV form on the ruled side, the plane/cylinder precedent); the 3D curve and the plane-UV lift stay exact. Classification uses outward binary64 bands widened by both recognition deviations; ring-plane coincidence reports coincident_trim, the apex contact and the parabola threshold band stay tangency_or_multiple_root, misses resolve empty. No numerical fallback anywhere; never authorizes topology changes.

behaviorChange: New read-only query intersectPlaneCone (brep_intersect_plane_cone); no existing query, op, or adapter behavior changed. Both dist budgets move once (geometry chunk 2,425,233 to 2,437,723 bytes measured, +12,490 for the frustum recognizer, conic classification, exact rational-quadratic clips and lifts — budget now 2,445,000; total 4,743,767 to 4,756,257 bytes measured — budget now 4,765,000)

limits.classificationBand: both recognition deviations + 16 binary64 epsilons of the radius/height/patch/offset scale
limits.angularSnapBand: 64 binary64 epsilons plus recognition-error angular allowances (pure-rounding tilt only) around the ruling-parallel angle sigma = |m|/sqrt(1+m^2)
limits.conicClip: closed-form rational-quadratic half-plane cuts per ring plane and per patch edge in the exact curve parameter (eccentric angle for the ellipse, line parameter for the circle/rulings, t of the (1+t^2)/(1-t^2) form for the hyperbola); extrema within the band of a boundary line are tangencies, never clipped through

limitations: Canonical operands only: the planar patch is the one-face open exact bilinear affine rectangle (plane operand first); the cone is the exact canonical conical frustum solid (true apex admitted, equal-radius frustum refused as a cylinder); everything else is an explicit unsupported_surface region, never a numerical fallback

The cone-side lift of the oblique ellipse/parabola/hyperbola is null: on the ruled rational side patches those conics have no exact low-degree rational UV representation, so cone_uv ships null rather than a numerical fit — the 3D conic and the plane-UV lift stay exact (the plane/cylinder oblique-ellipse precedent)

Side-surface contacts only (shared with the plane/cylinder cell): where the plane patch crosses a ring cap disk, the cap chord is not a component and coverage stays numerically_resolved, never certified complete

Tangency is never a point, a guessed line, or a guessed circle: the apex contact, ring-plane coincidence (coincident_trim), the parabola threshold band, ring-tangent conics and band-thin clips all stay unresolved, and the classification band widens with recognition deviation so near-tangent configurations below ~1e-13 of the scale stay unresolved rather than guessed

NumericallyResolved is not certified complete-domain coverage and permitsTopologyChange stays false; consuming these sections in Booleans and the remaining analytic SS pairs (torus family, non-parallel cylinder/cylinder, cone/cone) stay open
